verdict: Arm grew revenue 34% to a record second-quarter $1.14B, with royalties at a record $620M — and a $131M one-off gain on selling a business lifted GAAP net income to $238M, more than double a year ago.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago; a record second quarter

segments.name: License and other revenue
segments.note: Fees for licensing Arm chip designs, plus support and related services; up 56% YoY on the timing and size of high-value license agreements and contributions from backlog.

segments.name: Royalty revenue
segments.note: A cut of every chip shipped with Arm technology inside; up 21% YoY on higher royalty rates from newer designs such as Armv9 and Arm CSS, and more Arm-based chips in data centers.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Designing new processors and platform technology; the GAAP figure includes $197M of share-based pay (paying staff in shares) and $28M of related employer taxes.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company; the GAAP figure includes $61M of share-based pay and $9M of related employer taxes.

follow100Note: Royalties alone are $54.63 of every $100 Arm takes in. A one-off $131M gain on a business sale sits inside other income this quarter.
otherDetail: Combined other income was $139M: $27M of net interest income plus $128M of other non-operating income (which includes a $131M gain on the sale of a business), minus a $16M loss from equity investments (the separate equity line). Tax was a $64M charge, a 21.2% effective rate on $302M of pre-tax income.
footerNote: Arm calls its direct cost 'cost of sales' ($29M). Other income includes a one-off $131M gain on a business divestiture.

takeaways.title: Royalties set a record
takeaways.text: Royalty revenue rose 21% to a record $620M and license revenue jumped 56% to $515M, taking total revenue to $1,135M — Arm's third straight billion-dollar quarter, above the high end of guidance.

takeaways.title: A one-off gain flattered the bottom line
takeaways.text: GAAP net income more than doubled to $238M, but $131M of that came from a one-time gain on selling a business, booked in other income. Excluding one-offs and share-based pay, non-GAAP net income was $417M (EPS $0.39).

takeaways.title: Cash generation was strong
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $567M and non-GAAP free cash flow $411M in the quarter. Annualized contract value rose 28% to $1,600M, while remaining performance obligations were $2,246M.

oneTimers: Gain on business divestiture: $131M inside other non-operating income — a one-time gain on a sale; Arm excludes it from non-GAAP results.

sources.label: Official earnings release — shareholder letter, Form 6-K Exhibit 99.2 (SEC EDGAR)
